# RedRouter

RedRouter is a self-hosted gateway for AI model traffic. It exposes OpenAI-compatible and
Anthropic-compatible REST endpoints, so one base URL and one key reach many providers, with
combos providing routing and fallback. This entry skill covers setup, discovery and errors, and
indexes the capability skills. Fetch the capability skill you need from the table below.

## Install and start

```bash
npm install -g @reddb-io/red-router
red-router serve
```

The installed CLI listens on `127.0.0.1:25050` by default and stores its data under
`~/.red/router`. A checkout run with `pnpm dev` (or `npm run dev`) listens on port `20128`
instead. Use `red-router serve --host 0.0.0.0` only when network access is intentional.

## Setup

```bash
export RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL="http://localhost:25050"   # or your remote / tunnel URL, no trailing /v1
export RED_ROUTER_API_KEY="sk-..."                    # create one in Dashboard, API Keys
```

Every request goes to `${RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL}/v1/...` with the header
`Authorization: Bearer ${RED_ROUTER_API_KEY}`. Omit the header only when the instance does not
require an API key (a fresh loopback-only install).

Verify the server is up: `curl $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/api/health` returns `{"status":"ok",...}`.

## Discover models

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/models
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/models/web
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" "$RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/models/info?id=<model-id>"
```

`GET /v1/models` lists every model this key may use across all capabilities. Each entry has an
`id` in `provider/model` form (combos appear by their bare name) and a `type` that tells the
capability apart. Filter with jq, for example
`jq '.data[] | select(.type=="image") | .id'`. Use `data[].id` as the `model` field in requests.
`GET /v1/models/web` lists web search and web fetch entries, and `GET /v1/models/info?id=<id>`
returns per-model parameters and the endpoint that serves it.

## Errors

- 401: the key is missing, wrong or revoked. Set or rotate `RED_ROUTER_API_KEY`.
- 400: the request body or `model` is invalid. Check the id against `GET /v1/models`.
- 429 or 503: the provider or account is rate limited or temporarily unavailable. Honor
  `Retry-After`, add another provider connection, or route through a combo with fallback.
